# The IssuesShowcase stream test wheels before the load's scroll reset lands

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` › "streamed batches preserve the scrolled view through completion" fails intermittently in hosted CI on e2e-engine 11/14. Sightings: PR #21223 run 44022598356 (Playwright 1.65.0) and PR #21235 run 44040985556 (1.65.1, Dependabot). Both went green on retry, and the test passes locally. Each red costs a rerun and blocks the PR it lands on, Dependabot's auto-merge included.

## The Problem

```
Error: expect(received).toBeGreaterThan(expected)
Expected: > 300
Received:   0
  130 |         await view.hover();
  131 |         await page.mouse.wheel(0, 600);
> 132 |         await expect.poll(scrollTop).toBeGreaterThan(300);
```

## The Architectural Reality

- `store.load()` starts the stream with an ordinary load (no `postChunkLoad`, `count` 0). `src/data/Store.mjs` marks only later stream loads as `postChunkLoad` (`!!me.isStreaming && !isFirstChunk`).
- For an ordinary load, `src/grid/Body.mjs#onStoreLoad` dispatches `Neo.main.DomAccess.scrollTo({direction: 'top', value: 0})` after `me.timeout(50)`. Each grid body does this, three in this showcase.
- The test enqueues 200 rows, waits for `store.count` 200, and wheels once. Measured locally on dev `66ad791e01`, the order is: load t=285 (count 0) · batch t=290 (count 200, post) · 3 resets t=338. A wheel between 290 and the reset is undone when the reset reaches the main thread, and the poll never wheels again, so it reads 0 for 5 s. A slow runner widens that window.
- Red on purpose: the same test, with the resets' dispatch delayed 500 ms in the worker, fails 3/3 with exactly `Received: 0`.

Design authority: n/a, a test-only race (fenced error and spec path above). The reset itself is intended: an ordinary load opens at the top.

## The Fix

Test-only, in the spec: before `store.load()`, wrap `Neo.main.DomAccess.scrollTo` in the worker to record the view's scroll-to-top dispatches. Before the first batch, wait past the reset delay in the worker and await those dispatches, so the wheel lands on a settled view. Then assert per batch and at completion that no further reset was dispatched, the deterministic form of the spec's existing "observe past that boundary" check. Restore `scrollTo` in `finally`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With the resets' dispatch delayed 500 ms, the test is red without the guard and green with it.
- [ ] The test is green unthrottled and under 6× CPU throttle.
- [ ] Streamed batches assert that no further scroll-to-top is dispatched after the initial load's.

## Out of Scope

Other shard-11 flakes, such as `WorkstationGridRepaintNL.spec.mjs:310` (Grace's defect note).
